aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A stern, reserved woman and a playful younger partner navigate personal differences and societal pressures to form a deep, unconditional bond in this Cambodian GL drama.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: My Soulmate is a Cambodian drama series that explores the blossoming romance between two women with contrasting personalities. A guarded, serious professional finds her quiet life upended when a charming and persistent younger woman enters her world. Despite initial friction and emotional barriers, their affection deepens into genuine devotion. Together, they discover that true connection requires courage, trust, and loving without conditions.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: My Soulmate is a romantic Cambodian drama series centered on the evolving relationship between two women from distinct walks of life. One lead is a serious, reserved woman who maintains strict emotional distance to protect herself from vulnerability. Her structured existence is challenged when a vibrant, lighthearted younger woman enters her life with playful charm. Initial encounters spark resistance and amusement, as their opposing temperaments lead to comedic friction and tension. However, the younger woman's genuine warmth and persistent presence gradually weaken the older woman's guarded defenses. As they spend more time together, subtle affection grows into a powerful mutual attraction. The couple must contend with internal fears, past baggage, and external expectations that test their devotion. Through shared hardships and tender moments, both women learn to embrace vulnerability and support one another unconditionally. Ultimately, their shared journey illustrates how love can heal past wounds and transform lives when embraced wholeheartedly.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: My Soulmate (ស្នេហ៍គ្មានលក្ខណ្ឌ) is a Cambodian Girls' Love (GL) drama produced by Sastra Film that delves into the themes of love, self-discovery, and acceptance. The story centers on a stoic, emotionally distant woman and an energetic, expressive younger woman whose worlds collide unexpectedly. As playful interactions turn into deeper emotional moments, both leads are forced to confront their guarded hearts and societal expectations. Featuring tender character development and rich emotional dynamics, the series delivers an inspiring look at how genuine affection can transcend personal boundaries and bring two soulmates together.

story_structure.introduction: The protagonists are introduced within their distinct everyday lives, establishing their personal backgrounds, values, and initial perspectives on love before an unexpected encounter brings their paths together.
story_structure.risingAction: As shared experiences deepen their affection, unresolved personal secrets and external complications escalate, forcing both characters to navigate painful misunderstandings and difficult personal choices.
